inspection_method: git object inspection and partial working-tree inspection because Windows checkout hit filename-too-long paths; inspected README, Meta publish workflow, Vault Setup, Obsidian plugin config, GitHub Actions, and long-path examples

anchors.why: Describes KaaS as a personal knowledge vault with Obsidian Publish, GitHub Pages, MOCs, code snippets, lists, tools, and meta docs.
Documents develop as Obsidian working branch, main as converted GitHub representation, and gh-pages as MkDocs deployment.
Documents note types, source types, nested tags, utility notes, and workflow concepts.
Runs obsidian-export from develop to main and force-pushes converted Markdown.
Publishes the converted branch through MkDocs/GitHub Actions.
Shows a very large plugin dependency/runtime surface.
Windows checkout failed on long Readwise-derived file paths, showing retention and sync risk.

known_limits: This is a personal vault; content and taxonomy are not VAKS reviewed knowledge.
The convert-links workflow force-pushes generated output and must not be copied into VAKS default operations.
Large plugin surface and long paths create major portability and runtime risk.
